principle: Business-school tiers are evidence classifications, not official rankings.

tiers.T1: Verified high research/publication evidence + business PhD evidence + accreditation evidence.
tiers.T2: Verified business PhD + accreditation + research-network/Carnegie evidence.
tiers.T4: Verified accreditation evidence without enough research/doctoral evidence.
tiers.Unclassified: Insufficient verified evidence; no tier is assigned.

university_levels.meaning: Research-intensive level from an explicitly recorded institutional system.
Research-active level from an explicitly recorded institutional system.
Research-focused or comprehensive university label when explicitly recorded.

manual_override: Requires a reason and a public source URL; it is stored separately from automated evidence.
